text:
For hanging strips like Command strips, pull slowly straight down and parallel to the wall, stretching the strip along its length, and if it resists, warm it with a hairdryer for 20 to 30 seconds or saw behind it with dental floss. For medical wound-closure strips, don't pull them off: let them loosen and curl on their own over about 1 to 2 weeks, and see a clinician if they're still on after that or the wound looks infected. I've assumed hanging strips in the first part, so tell me if you meant medical strips.

CONFIDENCE: 70
